result.title: DynaSolver: A Neural Operator for Autoregressive 4D Flow Prediction with Dynamic Boundaries
result.summary: Neural operators provide efficient surrogates for computational fluid dynamics (CFD), but most are designed for static geometries and are not equipped to model unsteady flows induced by continuously moving boundaries. We study dynamic-boundary 4D CFD prediction for articulated moving geometries and introduce RoboCFD-4D, a temporally resolved robotic CFD benchmark spanning diverse morphologies and flow conditions. To address the computational and autoregressive challenges of this setting, we propose DynaSolver, a neural operator that explicitly conditions on boundary evolution and causal flow history. DynaSolver employs an efficient physical-token formulation that amortizes point-to-token projection across the operator stack, substantially reducing repeated point-space spatio-temporal computation while retaining accurate point-level reconstruction. We further introduce Replay-Augmented Parallel Training, which exposes the model to autoregressively generated histories while preserving parallel dense supervision, narrowing the gap between ground-truth-conditioned training and autoregressive rollout. Experiments on RoboCFD-4D show that DynaSolver achieves the best full-rollout accuracy among a broad range of learned CFD surrogates, with its advantage increasing as rollout proceeds, indicating substantially reduced autoregressive error accumulation. Project page: https://made-gpt.github.io/DynaSolver-ProjectPage.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究关节式运动边界下的动态边界 4D CFD 预测，构建了 RoboCFD-4D 基准，并提出显式以边界演化和因果流历史为条件的神经算子 DynaSolver，配合 Replay-Augmented Parallel Training 缓解自回归 rollout 的误差累积。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用自回归生成的历史做训练、同时保留并行稠密监督」以抑制长程误差累积的思路，可能为 latent 推理轨迹的训练监督与暴露偏差问题提供可核查的借鉴，但需评估状态空间与证据约束的可迁移性。
